outcome: An atom may declare a structured field it introduces: start accepts it when the field's parent resolves and the leaf does not exist yet, records it as introduced, and record-promotion refuses until the canonical module carries the leaf; a misspelled field and an introduced flag on an existing field are refused at start by name.
practical_value: Round 5 of the S12 roadmap adds three structured fields; the machinery can build those atoms without hiding the field's addition from the atom's own change record.
stopping_condition: The real refused round-5 request starts through the candidate controller and its promotion gate refuses until the field exists; the real misspelled request and an introduced-on-existing field are refused by name; the real structured-KPI request still starts; the promoted controller is installed to both projections at parity and the real request starts through the installed controller.

captured_cases.expected_outcome: The real round-5 request declaring activation_cards[].approver as introduced starts, and promotion refuses until the canonical module carries the field.
The real misspelled request is still refused at start with the available keys.
An introduced flag on a field the module already carries is refused by name.
The real structured-KPI request without any introduced flag still starts exactly as before.
